initial_state: Fresh licensed Apple Silicon studio, original two-fabric Harbor OBJ added as a garment at metre scale, 100%, Y-up, with UV tracing enabled. Simulation was paused for display comparisons.
action: Display > Garment Fit Maps > Strain Map toggled a floating map-control panel and changed the 3D surface display.

global.observed_scale: Eight adjacent cool-to-hot swatches, blue at left and red at right.

fabric.selection: The Fabric control displayed the two assigned material names with their color swatches, four directional percentages and warning icons.

method: Sampled the same interior rectangle of the 3D front and the interiors of both editable 2D patterns in on, off and repeat-on workspace captures. Every 3D sample changed on the first toggle and matched on the repeat. Both 2D samples retained every RGB value throughout.
limits: The native observation establishes controls, accepted range and display scope. The reference strain tensor, color thresholds, interpolation, compression response, response when the interval collapses to 100%, fabric calibration, stress and pressure measurement remain unverified.
This is a reference observation. It establishes no WeftForge numerical-equivalence or whole-feature verdict.
cleanup: The global range, grading and mesh controls were restored, the overlay toggled off, and the temporary scene closed without saving.
